phase_2_unsupervised.insight: Negative QS signals cluster in the CECUM — the specialized fermentation chamber. They have their own entropy distribution separate from healthy signals.

phase_3_refinement.method: Cluster cecum by signal type, identify waste taxonomy
refined_negative_qs_types: device_waste: unknown ARP entries broadcasting to be known (11 devices)
service_waste: listening ports with no clients (9 services)
announcement_waste: mDNS advertising to empty rooms (4 announcers)
hardware_waste: USB peripherals cycling with no audience (LED + fan hub)
rf_waste: neighbor WiFi leaking through walls (ambient noise)
